## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally (typecheck, lint, format, tests)

- [ ] No telemetry, network access, credentials or personal data added
- [ ] Third-party assets (if any) are listed in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` with a compatible licence
